title: Muon Anomalous Magnetic Moment from Substrate
status: Substrate s-quark HVP shift: ~11e-11 (~4% of discrepancy). Remaining 238e-11 (~5 sigma) likely from hadronic lattice QCD or DM loop. Tier-20 DM suppressed by (m_mu/m_DM)^2.
note: Full g-2 resolution requires non-perturbative hadronic lattice integration using substrate quark masses. Future work.
